newsitem.title: USA: Nuevo appoints new CEO after resignation.
newsitem.headline: Nuevo appoints new CEO after resignation.

text.p: Nuevo Energy Co said in a statement that it had appointed Douglas Foshee as its president and chief executive after Michael Watford resigned yesterday.
The company also said that company chairman J.P. Bryan will resign by the end of 1997, as he has to devote his attention to his job as chief executive at Gulf Canada Resources Ltd.
Bryan said that Nuevo would continue the strategies which had generated "the tremendous amount of shareholder value" of recent years.
Prior to his appointment, Foshee was president and CEO at Torch Energy Advisors Inc, the company which operates most of Nuevo's assets.
The company is holding a conference call at 1000 CDT to discuss the changes.
